body_lock: Both quadrupedal snowplow machines with four spring/armored legs and one compact upturned rear pipe tail. Scraplow has two round headlamp/eyestalk eyes, one flat shovel face blade, small rounded shell. Plowzer has low hood head with two actual face eyes, broad V plow blade, two snow-covered shoulder masses, heavy armored feet and compact curled pipe tail. Neither has arms, hands, human body or wheels.
